name: Assumption Log
purpose: The log records assumptions, which are planning factors treated as true without proof, and constraints, which are limiting factors such as a predetermined budget or fixed deliverable milestones. It is a living document that is updated throughout the project; assumptions are elaborated over time and are eventually validated, at which point they stop being assumptions.

elements.guidance: An identifier for the assumption or constraint.
The category of the assumption or constraint.
A description of the assumption or constraint.
The person tasked with following up on the assumption to find out whether it is true.
The date by which the assumption needs to be validated.
Actions needed to validate the assumption.
The status of the assumption, for example active, transferred or closed.
Any additional information about the assumption or constraint.

tailoring: Combine the assumption log with the issue register and the decision log to make an AID Log (A = assumption, I = issue, D = decision), for example a spreadsheet with one sheet for each.
On a very large project, keep the constraints in a separate log from the assumptions.
